## Summary / الملخص

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Problem it solves / المشكلة التي يحلها

Explain why this change is needed.

## Proposed solution / الحل المقترح

Describe the preferred outcome at a high level.

## Alternatives considered / بدائل تم التفكير بها

List any alternatives you considered.

## Additional context / معلومات إضافية

Add links, mockups, or examples if they help explain the request.
